Administrators can open administration pages and see other people's contact methods.

Where people are set

Set in /etc/mmhotline/mmhotline_settings.yml, in people. An administrator edits the settings file with sudoedit, then runs sudo mmhotline settings apply.

The settings file adds, changes, and removes people. Removing a person stops sign-in and keeps the person's history.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
